channel.title: Paksh: Economy
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Debate over Chicago's data center capacity
item.description: Concerns have been raised regarding Chicago's capacity to accommodate multiple new data centers. The discussion centers on the city's infrastructure and its ability to support such developments. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Intel CEO Notes Rapid Chinese Adoption of Frontier AI Models
item.description: Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger stated that the adoption of frontier artificial intelligence (AI) models in China has been 'very fast'. He also commented that quantum computing could become mainstream within the next three to five years. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.
